close_reason: Structural constraint: in-process filter requires full mailbox fetch; no way to push filter to backend without a new trait method.
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_query: the handler calls get_objects::<Mailbox>(None) to load all mailboxes, then filters in-process. For accounts with thousands of mailboxes this is O(n) in data loaded. The handler cannot push filter predicates to the backend because the filter is applied in-process. This is documented but the design means a backend with 10K mailboxes loads all 10K per query. The MailBackend::query_objects interface does accept a filter, so the handler could call query_objects::<Mailbox> and let the backend filter. The in-process approach was chosen because the backend impl may not support Mailbox filtering, but this could be made opt-in via a capability method (similar to can_calculate_mailbox_query_changes).
title: Mailbox/query always fetches all mailboxes O(n) before filtering
